name: get_drug_interactions
description: Drug-drug interaction lookup from DDInter database
usage: from app.tools.biomni.pharmacology import get_drug_interactions; result = get_drug_interactions('warfarin')

parameters.drug_name: str — drug name to look up
parameters.top_k: int — number of interactions to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: drug, interactions (list of {interacting_drug, severity, mechanism})
